paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County Chamber Main Street has marked a ribbon cutting for Jackson Hewitt Tax Service in Pontotoc, sharing photographs of the ceremony in a Monday, Oct. 26, announcement. The Chamber said the gathering took place the previous week; it did not give an exact ceremony date.

The photos show the business’s sign and a blue ribbon outside the office marked 2348A. Jackson Hewitt’s own listing identifies the location as 2348 Highway 15 North, Suite A, in Pontotoc. The office page asks customers to call 662-600-6117 to book an appointment.

The company lists the office as open year-round, with services including tax preparation, amendments and extensions. Residents planning a visit can check the specific office page linked below for appointment information.
